title: API-Gateway Demand Order Request
description: Ingress payload produced by api/routers/orders.py and consumed by demand_prophet / inventory_sentinel / orchestrator via the synapse.orders.demand topic (ADR-029).

order_id.description: Per-order UUID. Optional — emitted by API gateway for traceability, NOT by the consensus layer (which uses decision_id).

quantity.description: Cap at 1000 prevents accidental enormous orders from saturating downstream agents.

idempotency_key.description: Echoed from the Idempotency-Key header for downstream dedup.
